generalAbilities.name: Compression
generalAbilities.description: A muckish creep can move through a gap at least 6 inches wide without Squeezing and can Squeeze through any gap at least 1 inch wide.

generalAbilities.name: Mud Trail
generalAbilities.description: When a muckish creep Strides or Steps, it leaves behind a slimy mud trail that coats the traversed area. All traversed squares are covered in Grease (DC 26 Reflex Saving Throw or DC 26 Acrobatics ) until the start of the muckish creep's next turn.

generalAbilities.name: Slippery Body
generalAbilities.description: A muckish creep's body allows it to slip away from most restraints. It gains a +4 status bonus to checks to Escape. On a success, it gets a critical success instead. On a critical failure, it gets a failure instead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Elude Grasp
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature succeeds at an attempt to Grapple the muckish creep.

Effect The muckish creep attempts an Athletics check to Escape.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blinding Mud
offensiveAbilities.description: When a muckish creep hits a creature with a mud ball Strike, that creature becomes Dazzled (or Blinded on a critical hit). The creature can use an Interact action to wipe away the mud and remove the dazzled or blinded condition.

offensiveAbilities.name: Overwhelm
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The muckish creep has a creature grabbed.

Effect The muckish creep fills the grabbed creature's mouth and nose with mud. The creature begins to suffocate unless it succeeds at a DC 23 Fortitude Saving Throw save. The suffocating creature or any adjacent creatures can clear the suffocating creature's airway with an Interact action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
